name: Competitive Clean
audience: Players prioritizing rapid reads, fair visibility and low input friction.
camera: Third-person action camera; test targets at maximum engagement distance.
identity: Chevron cutouts and layered lane rails form an original modular sports-space vocabulary.

palette.rule: Separate teams by silhouette, pattern and labeling as well as color; neutral environment stays subdued.

geometry: Low-noise modular lanes, clean collision silhouettes and clear sightline borders.

materials.surfaces: Matte court composite, smooth metal rails and minimal grip strips.
materials.texture_rule: Low-frequency surfaces; no distracting cracks, specular glare or camouflage.
materials.tiling_rule: Repeat court patterns only where alignment supports spatial reading; inspect at match camera.

lighting: Even exposure with stable target contrast; avoid deep shadows at combat intersections.
effects: Short-lived hit and direction cues with occlusion limits; no lingering view-blocking particles.
ui: Prioritize timer, objective and team readability; phone touch targets and keyboard/controller parity.
audio: Distinct directional impacts and objective stingers, low-masking background rhythm.

budgets.reuse_rule: Use a small arena kit and shared surface palette; favor geometry over unique textures.

originality: Invent competition branding, shapes and arenas; do not echo existing Roblox game emblems or HUDs.
